faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Research Scientist III (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Research Scientist III (Medical) recruitment is 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MBBS/BVSc/BDS/BAMS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc/MDS/MPH) and three years of experience in health research, or an MBBS/BVSc/BDS/BAMS degree with MPH/PhD and three years of experience in health research.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist III (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist III (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 93,000 per month, plus 20% HRA of the basic pay.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist III (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist III (Medical) position at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist III (Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications, followed by a written test and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the contract period for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job. The project end date is mentioned as 30th March 2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
